choice:13:1:2.female: Was Gorgonna really the goddess' chosen emissary?

say:9:1510810007:0.text: As for you, long-horns, you'd better sit this one out. If you charge in now, you'll be surrounded, with no allies on either side.

say:0:1510811001:0.text: The sounds are definitely coming from the outpost.

say:0:1510813001:0.male: So... it's official. The Wildborn and Halians are at war.
say:0:1510813001:0.female: So... it's official. The Wildborn and Halians are at war.

say:1:1510814002:0.text: They've gained the power of a goddess!

say:2:1510815001:0.text: Those Wildborn... they've been <style="highlight">blessed by the Hunting Goddess</style>! They've got unimaginable power!
say:2:1510815001:0.source_cn: 那、那些兽人……他们得到了<style=highlig...

say:3:1510815002:0.text: Esteemed mages... Lady Merlin, please help us!
say:3:1510815002:0.source_cn: 几位魔法师大人……梅林女士！求你们救救我们！

choice_prompt:4:1510815002.text: Esteemed mages... Lady Merlin, please help us!
choice_prompt:4:1510815002.source_cn: 几位魔法师大人……梅林女士！求你们救救我们！

say:6:1510815003:0.text: What are you standing around for?! Grab your weapon and fight! Those savage Wildborn are tearing through the front!
say:6:1510815003:0.source_cn: 你在这里做什么？！快拿起武器去战斗！那群野蛮的兽人要冲...

say:7:1510815004:0.text: Lieutenant, wait! These mages might be able to save our comrades!
say:7:1510815004:0.source_cn: 副将大人，这些人是魔法师，或许有办法救咱们的战友！

say:8:1510815005:0.text: Mages? Don't make me laugh. They're the ones who brought the flood!
say:8:1510815005:0.source_cn: ——狗屁魔法师！他们是引发洪水的罪魁祸首！

choice_prompt:9:1510815005.text: Mages? Don't make me laugh. They're the ones who brought the flood!
choice_prompt:9:1510815005.source_cn: ——狗屁魔法师！他们是引发洪水的罪魁祸首！

say:10:1510815007:0.text: Soldiers, listen well! These spell-slingers are in league with the Wildborn!
say:10:1510815007:0.source_cn: 士兵，听令！这些人是雅库伯尔的走狗，呼临的敌人！

say:11:1510815008:0.text: Surround them! Cut off their heads! Let them taste—
say:11:1510815008:0.source_cn: 包围他们，割下他们的头！叫他们也尝尝——

narration:16:1510815010:0.text: An arrow flies at you—Morgan swings his scythe and splits it in two.
narration:16:1510815010:0.source_cn: 一支利箭朝你们飞来，摩根挥动镰刀，将其劈成两截

say:19:1510815012:0.text: You're cornered now. Offer your blood to the Wild Moon!
say:19:1510815012:0.source_cn: 你们无处可逃，将鲜血献给雅库伯尔之月吧！！

choice:9:1:2.text: Do you want to save your men or not?!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你难道不想救这些士兵了吗？
choice:9:1:2.male: Do you want to save your men or not?!
choice:9:1:2.female: Do you want to save your men or not?!

say:22:1510815006:0.text: Hah! Showing your true loyalties, are you?!
say:22:1510815006:0.male: Hah! Showing your true loyalties, are you?!
say:22:1510815006:0.female: Hah! Showing your true loyalties, are you?!

choice:9:2:3.text: Keep being like that and I'll help the Wildborn!
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 你再说，我就去帮雅库伯尔！
choice:9:2:3.male: Keep being like that and I'll help the Wildborn!
choice:9:2:3.female: Keep being like that and I'll help the Wildborn!

choice:4:1:2.text: So this is true divine power...
choice:4:1:2.male: So this is true divine power...
choice:4:1:2.female: So this is true divine power...

say:0:1510818001:0.text: How long can your light wall hold? The Wildborn won't stop here.
say:0:1510818001:0.source_cn: 这道光墙能撑多久？雅库伯尔不会轻易放弃攻击。
say:0:1510818001:0.male: How long can your light wall hold? The Wildborn won't stop here.
say:0:1510818001:0.female: How long can your light wall hold? The Wildborn won't stop here.

say:1:1510819001:0.text: Why did you divide the battlefield?!
say:1:1510819001:0.source_cn: 你们做了什么？为什么要分割战场？！

say:2:1510819002:0.text: Withdraw your sorcery, or I'll have you executed!
say:2:1510819002:0.source_cn: 撤回你们的巫术，否则我以军令处决你们！

choice_prompt:3:1510819002.text: Withdraw your sorcery, or I'll have you executed!
choice_prompt:3:1510819002.source_cn: 撤回你们的巫术，否则我以军令处决你们！

say:4:1510819003:0.text: Stop acting all righteous! What are you scheming now?!
say:4:1510819003:0.source_cn: 少装出一副大义凛然的样子！你们又有什么阴谋诡计？！
say:4:1510819003:0.male: Stop acting all righteous! What are you scheming now?!
say:4:1510819003:0.female: Stop acting all righteous! What are you scheming now?!

say:6:1510819004:0.text: Oh, please. Before you go frothing at the mouth again, maybe glance behind you? At the bleeding soldiers your bravado couldn't save?
say:6:1510819004:0.source_cn: 啊，说这话之前，不如先看看你背后流血的士兵，再看看光墙...

say:7:1510819005:1.text: If Merlin hadn't acted, you'd be counting bodies, not barking orders.
say:7:1510819005:1.source_cn: 要不是梅林，谁能保你手下士兵的命？

say:12:1510819008:0.text: You should have died with the Halians—gutted, fed to wolves. But the Wildborn will praise you for one thing.
say:12:1510819008:0.source_cn: 你本该被木桩穿刺，万兽噬咬，流尽鲜血而死。但雅库伯尔会...
say:12:1510819008:0.male: You should have died with the Halians—gutted, fed to wolves. But the Wildborn will praise you for one thing.
say:12:1510819008:0.female: You should have died with the Halians—gutted, fed to wolves. But the Wildborn will praise you for one thing.

say:15:1510819010:1.text: Filth, all of you! I should put every last one of you down to bring peace to the countless Halian souls above!
say:15:1510819010:1.source_cn: 哼，一丘之貉！我该把你们全部杀光，慰藉万千呼临的在天之灵！

say:17:1510819011:1.text: Pathetic. You talk like a rusty sword, and you're about as sharp as one too.
say:17:1510819011:1.source_cn: 可笑，你的脑子还没有骷髅灵光。骷髅甚至没有大脑。

say:19:1510819012:1.text: Enough. This isn't the time. We need to move.
say:19:1510819012:1.source_cn: ……不是谈话的时机，我们先离开。

say:21:1510819013:0.text: I'm not letting you get away!

choice:3:0:1.text: You're not giving the orders here.
choice:3:0:1.male: You're not giving the orders here.
choice:3:0:1.female: You're not giving the orders here.

choice:3:1:2.text: That wall's the only thing keeping you alive!
choice:3:1:2.male: That wall's the only thing keeping you alive!
choice:3:1:2.female: That wall's the only thing keeping you alive!

narration:0:1510819301:0.text: Merlin raises her staff, and you vanish right before the lieutenant's face.
narration:0:1510819301:0.source_cn: 初代梅林挥动法杖，副将的面孔在你面前消失了
narration:0:1510819301:0.male: Merlin raises her staff, and you vanish right before the lieutenant's face.
narration:0:1510819301:0.female: Merlin raises her staff, and you vanish right before the lieutenant's face.

narration:1:1510819302:0.text: Behind the light wall, both armies continue their assault.
narration:1:1510819302:0.source_cn: 在稍远的地方，呼临人和雅库伯尔仍在试图破坏光墙

say:1:1510819401:0.text: Merlin, your <style="highlight">light wall spell</style> can only stall them for a while. You can't maintain it forever.

say:2:1510819402:0.text: Your precious magic shouldn't be wasted like this.
say:2:1510819402:0.source_cn: 你宝贵的魔力不该浪费在这种地方。

choice_prompt:3:1510819402.text: Your precious magic shouldn't be wasted like this.
choice_prompt:3:1510819402.source_cn: 你宝贵的魔力不该浪费在这种地方。

say:4:1510819403:0.text: Cute idea. Neither of us is capable of that.
say:4:1510819403:0.source_cn: 我没那个本事，你也没那个本事。
say:4:1510819403:0.male: Cute idea. Neither of us is capable of that.
say:4:1510819403:0.female: Cute idea. Neither of us is capable of that.

say:5:1510819404:0.text: Morgan's right. As long as someone still wants to fight, the war won't end. No matter how many barriers we raise, they'll be broken sooner or later.
say:5:1510819404:0.source_cn: 摩根说的没错。只要还有人想战，战争就不会停止。无论我们...
say:5:1510819404:0.male: Morgan's right. As long as someone still wants to fight, the war won't end. No matter how many barriers we raise, they'll be broken sooner or later.
say:5:1510819404:0.female: Morgan's right. As long as someone still wants to fight, the war won't end. No matter how many barriers we raise, they'll be broken sooner or later.

say:6:1510819405:0.text: And with divine blessing on their side, the Wildborn will overwhelm everything in their path.
say:6:1510819405:0.source_cn: 雅库伯尔人身披狩猎神的加护，一旦双方再度短兵相接，战场...

say:7:1510819406:0.text: Not just the border camp, but Halia itself may fall. Those who survive will become prisoners... or corpses.
say:7:1510819406:0.source_cn: 不止交界的水泽营地，或许连呼临城也会被雅库伯尔占领。走...

say:8:1510819407:0.text: This is the worst-case scenario... and the future we must prevent.
say:8:1510819407:0.source_cn: 这是最坏的情况……也是我们必须阻止的未来。

choice_prompt:9:1510819407.text: This is the worst-case scenario... and the future we must prevent.
choice_prompt:9:1510819407.source_cn: 这是最坏的情况……也是我们必须阻止的未来。

say:10:1510819408:0.text: There's only one path left. We must <style="highlight">rescue Perseus</style>.

say:11:1510819409:0.text: He's the only one with the authority to stop Halia's army. If even one side lays down arms, we might have a chance.
say:11:1510819409:0.source_cn: 能阻止呼临军队的，只有他。只要有一方愿意停战，我们就能...

say:12:1510819410:0.text: Rescue him from where exactly? His tomb?

choice_prompt:13:1510819410.text: Rescue him from where exactly? His tomb?

say:14:1510819411:0.text: Hah. Maybe not anymore. The Hunting Goddess isn't known for being merciful.
say:14:1510819411:0.source_cn: 现在未必。那位狩猎神听着不是心慈手软的家伙。
say:14:1510819411:0.male: Hah. Maybe not anymore. The Hunting Goddess isn't known for being merciful.
say:14:1510819411:0.female: Hah. Maybe not anymore. The Hunting Goddess isn't known for being merciful.

say:15:1510819412:0.text: Let's contact Nazrik while the light wall still holds.
say:15:1510819412:0.source_cn: 用传讯石联络那非吧，趁光墙还能坚持一段时间。

narration:16:1510819413:0.text: You use the echo stone and relay the situation to Nazrik...
narration:16:1510819413:0.source_cn: 你们用传讯石联络上那非，将战场上的情况告诉了他……

say:18:1510819414:0.text: At this point, if we want to stabilize this situation and end the war, there's only one last option—<style="highlight">rescue Perseus and help him stop the war</style>.
say:18:1510819414:0.source_cn: ……此时此刻，再想稳定局势、平息战争，唯有<style...

say:19:1510819415:0.text: Nazrik, I ask you once more. Please hunt again, help us find him.
say:19:1510819415:0.source_cn: 那非，恳请你再次追猎，帮我们找到珀尔修斯的下落。

say:21:1510819416:0.text: ... And why would I do that?

say:26:1510819418:0.text: I'm a Wildborn. You're asking me to help rescue the general of Halia?
say:26:1510819418:0.source_cn: 我是雅库伯尔人，帮你们救呼临的统帅……怎么可能？

say:27:1510819419:0.text: Whether Halia stands or burns, it's no concern of mine.
say:27:1510819419:0.source_cn: 呼临城失不失守，呼临人是死是活，与我无关。

choice_prompt:28:1510819419.text: Whether Halia stands or burns, it's no concern of mine.
choice_prompt:28:1510819419.source_cn: 呼临城失不失守，呼临人是死是活，与我无关。

say:30:1510819423:0.text: Halia drew first blood. They invaded us first. We're owed a reckoning.
say:30:1510819423:0.source_cn: 呼临人侵占雅库伯尔在先，理应受到惩罚。

say:31:1510819424:0.text: Compared to that... what's a little accusation of treason?
say:31:1510819424:0.source_cn: 比起正义……被当成叛徒又有什么要紧？

say:34:1510819425:0.text: Your loyalty to the Wildborn is greater than I expected.
say:34:1510819425:0.source_cn: 那非，你对雅库伯尔的忠心几乎超出我的预料。

say:35:1510819426:0.text: When we stayed in Glowhaven, you never told us what happened during the Bloodhunt Festival. But as a mage who's traveled far, I've learned a bit about the Wildborn's traditions.
say:35:1510819426:0.source_cn: 尽管在微光憩居时，你未曾讲述猎血节的始末。但作为一名游...

say:36:1510819427:0.text: I know what that festival entails. How many lives were thrown away to please your goddess, how the best hunters eventually became prey, staining the forest red.
say:36:1510819427:0.source_cn: 我知道猎血节有多么残酷，知道曾有多少人葬身于这场取悦狩...

say:37:1510819428:1.text: Across the lands, there is no deity more insatiable.
say:37:1510819428:1.source_cn: 放眼整片大陆，没有任何一位神明，如同狩猎神这般嗜血。

say:38:1510819429:1.text: You saw firsthand how the Arcane Council tried to challenge a god. You know what I'm trying to do.
say:38:1510819429:1.source_cn: 你亲眼目睹过魔法师协会试图弑神……应当明白我的目的所在。

say:41:1510819431:0.text: You want to <style="highlight">kill the Hunting Goddess</style>.

say:44:1510819432:0.text: Not for myself. For your people. Just as I pursued the fallen Sarethiel to save Halia, I would do the same here for the Wildborn.
say:44:1510819432:0.source_cn: 不，不是我想。是为了你，为了雅库伯尔。正如我追逐堕落的...

say:45:1510819433:0.text: Tell me, what is the difference between her actions and those of a fallen god? If she's this merciless now, what would become of the Wildborn if she were to fall?
say:45:1510819433:0.source_cn: 请想想看吧：狩猎神的所作所为与堕神有何区别？她尚未堕落...

say:46:1510819434:0.text: If you let it all happen... is that the justice you seek?
say:46:1510819434:0.source_cn: 默许一切发生，那是你所追寻的正义吗？

say:47:1510819435:0.text: Even good intentions, over time, can turn into the worst kind of evil.
say:47:1510819435:0.source_cn: 主观善行，也会在时间长河中逐渐发酵，最终酿成最大的恶意...

say:50:1510819437:0.text: Someone promised me the Hunting Goddess would fall.
say:50:1510819437:0.source_cn: 有人向我保证过，狩猎神终将陨落。

choice_prompt:51:1510819437.text: Someone promised me the Hunting Goddess would fall.
choice_prompt:51:1510819437.source_cn: 有人向我保证过，狩猎神终将陨落。

say:56:1510819439:0.text: A twin soul? Wow, your value just skyrocketed! Quick, spill it. What's going on here?
say:56:1510819439:0.source_cn: 一体双魂？你的存在价值大大增加了！快，讲清楚，怎么回事？

say:58:1510819440:0.text: I think I've made my answer clear.

say:59:1510819443:0.text: The real focus here isn't me. It's her, the Hunting Goddess.
say:59:1510819443:0.source_cn: 重点不在我，而在她，狩猎神。

say:60:1510819444:0.text: She ordered the death of countless souls. Devoted followers, her own people.
say:60:1510819444:0.source_cn: 她授意杀了很多人。那些人都是虔诚的信徒，是她的子民。

say:61:1510819445:0.text: If Perseus returns to the battlefield, is there a chance... could you work together to bring her down?
say:61:1510819445:0.source_cn: 如果让珀尔修斯回到战场，他是不是有可能——你们与他联手...

say:65:1510819447:0.text: And if I fail... I'll keep trying, until the day she falls.
say:65:1510819447:0.source_cn: 即便这次没能成功，我也会继续追逐，直至她陨落的那一刻。

say:69:1510819449:0.text: Nazrik vanishes briefly, then reappears, his face shadowed.
say:69:1510819449:0.source_cn: 那非的身影消失了。片刻后，他再度出现，神情严肃。

say:71:1510819450:0.text: ... The trail leads to the <style="highlight">Primal Shrine</style>.

say:72:1510819451:0.text: <style="highlight">The signal's faint</style>. I can't even confirm it's Perseus. There's interference like last time.

choice_prompt:73:1510819451.text: <style="highlight">The signal's faint</style>. I can't even confirm it's Perseus. There's interference like last time.
choice_prompt:73:1510819451.source_cn: <style=highlight>指示很模糊</style>。我甚至不知道在追踪的是不是珀尔修斯。上次也是一样。

say:76:1510819452:0.text: Likely interference from the Hunting Goddess herself. Nazrik's tracking ability comes from her—if she's descending, her presence would obscure his sight.
say:76:1510819452:0.source_cn: 可能是狩猎神的神力，那非的追猎之能拜她所赐，或许也会受...
say:76:1510819452:0.male: Likely interference from the Hunting Goddess herself. Nazrik's tracking ability comes from her—if she's descending, her presence would obscure his sight.
say:76:1510819452:0.female: Likely interference from the Hunting Goddess herself. Nazrik's tracking ability comes from her—if she's descending, her presence would obscure his sight.

say:78:1510819453:0.text: Hmph. Then it might be a trap.

say:81:1510819454:0.text: Even so, it's our only lead.

say:82:1510819455:1.text: The Arcane Council thanks you, Nazrik. You've given us a direction.
say:82:1510819455:1.source_cn: 魔法师协会感谢你，那非，你为我们指明了方向。

say:84:1510819456:0.text: Sacrificing blood and lives to select the "strongest", condemning dozens of warriors to death... I never want to witness such a scene again.
say:84:1510819456:0.source_cn: 以鲜血和生命为祭，为了选拔最强者而断送几十位战士的生命...

say:85:1510819457:0.text: If faith means killing your own to prove your worth, then I want no part of it.
say:85:1510819457:0.source_cn: 如果只能追随这样的神明，我宁可不要神的庇护。

say:86:1510819458:0.text: Good luck. Gala's starting to groan again.

say:2:1510820001:1.text: So this is... the Primal Shrine.

say:3:1510820002:1.text: The scent of blood seeps from the stone. You can smell it even here.
say:3:1510820002:1.source_cn: 石料中散发出血腥味，在这里都能闻到。

say:4:1510820003:1.text: The Hunting Goddess' fondness for violence clearly runs deep.
say:4:1510820003:1.source_cn: 看来那位狩猎神对血的热爱持续了很久。

say:5:1510820004:1.text: Shrines are sacred spaces; we can't just barge in. Especially not here. The Hunting Goddess is far more alert than Sarethiel.
say:5:1510820004:1.source_cn: 神殿是神的领域，不能贸然闯入。何况是司掌狩猎领域的神明...

say:6:1510820005:1.text: Come closer. I'll <style="highlight">use magic to mask our presence</style>.

say:0:1510821001:0.text: But even cloaked, we should move cautiously inside.
say:0:1510821001:0.source_cn: 虽然有隐匿魔法，进入神殿以后还是要万加小心。

say:2:1510822001:1.text: The air just shifted... Are we still in the shrine?
say:2:1510822001:1.source_cn: 氛围变了。这还在神殿内吗？

say:3:1510822002:1.text: It feels like we're back in the forest.
say:3:1510822002:1.source_cn: 好像又回到了丛林，只有潮气。

say:4:1510822003:1.source_cn: 珀尔修斯可能会在这里的某处……

say:5:1510822004:1.text: There's a <style="highlight">platform</style> ahead. Manmade, by the look of it. Let's investigate.
say:5:1510822004:1.source_cn: 前方似乎有一座人造的<style=highlight>...

say:0:1510823001:1.text: You lower your head. The structure resembles the altars used in Tuttleton to honor the God of Harvest—though the carvings differ.
say:0:1510823001:1.source_cn: 你垂下头，这座石台与图塔镇人祭祀丰饶神的台座构造十分相...

say:1:1510823002:1.text: It's likely for ritual purposes... perhaps meant for a god.
say:1:1510823002:1.source_cn: 它应该也与祭祀，或是神明有关。或许……

say:2:1510824002:1.text: There's a groove on the surface. Like the altar for Sarethiel, it probably requires <style="highlight">something specific</style> to be placed in it.
say:2:1510824002:1.source_cn: 顶部有一个凹槽，可能和丰饶神那时候一样，需要将styl...

say:4:1510824003:1.text: In a shrine surrounded by water and wilderness... what kind of offering would it accept?
say:4:1510824003:1.source_cn: 狩猎神殿内，四面环水的荒岛……此地会有什么样的信物？

say:10:1510824006:1.text: The Wildborn revere the Hunting Goddess. They wouldn't enter this place lightly. But Halian soldiers who followed Perseus... they might've fled in here, desperate.
say:10:1510824006:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔人信仰狩猎神，不会主动闯入神殿。跟随珀尔修斯袭...

say:11:1510824007:1.text: Whatever it is, we stay alert.
say:11:1510824007:1.source_cn: 不管是什么，我们都得提高警惕。

choice:9:1:2.text: How could anyone else be in here?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 神殿里怎么会有其他人？
choice:9:1:2.male: How could anyone else be in here?
choice:9:1:2.female: How could anyone else be in here?

say:1:1510826001:0.text: A Halian? You're on Wildborn land. Who are you, and what are you doing here?
say:1:1510826001:0.source_cn: 呼临人，此处是雅库伯尔的领地，你是谁？来做什么？

say:2:1510826002:0.text: Do the Wildborn not have a word for "thank you"?
say:2:1510826002:0.source_cn: 在兽人的语言里，是不是没有“谢谢”这个词？

say:4:1510826004:1.text: Fine. Since you're unhurt, be careful heading back.
say:4:1510826004:1.source_cn: 既然你没受伤，自己回去的时候多加小心。

say:5:1510826005:0.source_cn: 等等，你还没有回答我的问题。

say:6:1510826006:0.text: And if I don't? You're going to stab me with that spear?
say:6:1510826006:0.source_cn: 如果我拒绝回答，你打算用手中的枪刺向我吗？

say:7:1510826007:0.text: That depends. On my mood, not your answer.
say:7:1510826007:0.source_cn: 这和你的回答无关，要看我的心情。

say:11:1510826011:0.text: Mhm. I permit you to call me that.
say:11:1510826011:0.source_cn: 嗯，我允许你这样呼唤我。

say:13:1510826013:0.text: Perseus... Do you regret saving me?
say:13:1510826013:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯，你在后悔，你后悔救了我。

say:14:1510826014:0.text: Maybe I will, someday. But not today.
say:14:1510826014:0.source_cn: 也许以后会，至少现在不。

say:15:1510826015:0.text: I'm going to <style="highlight">search for my spear</style> now.

say:19:1510826018:0.text: That woman, Gorgonna, that's the one Perseus loved. The one who died.
say:19:1510826018:0.source_cn: 那位雅库伯尔女性，就是珀尔修斯死去的恋人，露。

choice_prompt:20:1510826022.text: We're in the Hunting Goddess' shrine. Under divine power, nothing behaves as it should...
choice_prompt:20:1510826022.source_cn: 这里是狩猎神的神殿，神力之下，一切都不能用常理推断……

say:21:1510826019:0.text: That was just illusion magic, dunce.
say:21:1510826019:0.male: That was just illusion magic, dunce.
say:21:1510826019:0.female: That was just illusion magic, dunce.

say:22:1510826020:0.text: It was an <style="highlight">illusion built from memory</style>.

choice_prompt:23:1510826024.text: Merlin, be honest—are you just dying to pluck my memories out and stash them in your room like souvenirs?
choice_prompt:23:1510826024.source_cn: 嗯，是<style=highlight>根据记忆构建的幻象</style>。

say:24:1510826021:0.text: Gorgonna was a living sacrifice to the Hunting Goddess. If there's a spell that can preserve the memories of the dead, I'd love to study it.
say:24:1510826021:0.source_cn: 露是献给狩猎神的活祭祭品，如果有什么魔法能保存死人的记...
say:24:1510826021:0.male: Gorgonna was a living sacrifice to the Hunting Goddess. If there's a spell that can preserve the memories of the dead, I'd love to study it.
say:24:1510826021:0.female: Gorgonna was a living sacrifice to the Hunting Goddess. If there's a spell that can preserve the memories of the dead, I'd love to study it.

say:28:1510826025:0.source_cn: 也许会很有趣呢，有机会我试一试。

choice_prompt:29:1510826029.source_cn: 也许会很有趣呢，有机会我试一试。

say:30:1510826026:0.text: Sure. I'll invite you when the time comes.
say:30:1510826026:0.male: Sure. I'll invite you when the time comes.
say:30:1510826026:0.female: Sure. I'll invite you when the time comes.

say:31:1510826027:0.text: You two... never mind. I brought this on myself.
say:31:1510826027:0.source_cn: 你们两个……算了，是我自找的。
say:31:1510826027:0.male: You two... never mind. I brought this on myself.
say:31:1510826027:0.female: You two... never mind. I brought this on myself.

say:32:1510826028:0.text: Let's keep moving. I'm curious what scene comes next.
say:32:1510826028:0.source_cn: 继续往前走吧，我很好奇他们的下一场戏会演什么。

choice:29:0:1.text: If you do, I want to see them too.
choice:29:0:1.male: If you do, I want to see them too.
choice:29:0:1.female: If you do, I want to see them too.

say:0:1510829001:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯的长枪变化了。

say:5:1510830004:0.text: All this romance... how did the Hunting Goddess resist smashing his skull in?
say:5:1510830004:0.source_cn: 全是无聊的爱情戏，狩猎神怎么能忍住不碾碎他的颅骨。

choice_prompt:6:1510830004.text: All this romance... how did the Hunting Goddess resist smashing his skull in?

say:7:1510830005:1.source_cn: 这也太俗了……你的品味堪忧。

say:10:1510830010:0.text: Whoever cast this was exceptionally skilled. I've got no leads, but maybe it'll help us track down Perseus.

choice:6:0:1.text: I kind of like this sort of drama.
choice:6:0:1.male: I kind of like this sort of drama.
choice:6:0:1.female: I kind of like this sort of drama.

say:13:1510830006:1.female: Don't start with me. Remember his face back in Halia? The grief over Gorgonna's sacrifice? Where's the beauty in that?

choice:6:1:2.female: You don't understand the beauty of love.

say:0:1510831001:0.source_cn: 这颗记忆球似乎可以放置于台座上。

say:0:1510835001:0.text: Gorgonna... she's still waiting for me.

say:2:1510837001:0.text: You never told me you could heal... Why didn't you say so?
say:2:1510837001:0.source_cn: 你从来没说过你擅长治疗……为什么不告诉我？

say:3:1510837002:0.text: Why are you asking that now?

say:4:1510837003:0.text: I'm starting to realize how little I know about you.
say:4:1510837003:0.source_cn: 因为我觉得自己不够了解你。

say:5:1510837004:0.text: Does it matter? I've already kissed you.
say:5:1510837004:0.source_cn: 那重要吗？我已经吻过你了。

say:6:1510837005:0.source_cn: ……你总是让我不知该如何反驳。

say:7:1510837006:0.text: Even with Sarethiel's spear, you still got hurt. You're an idiot...
say:7:1510837006:0.source_cn: 有赛图恩的枪还会受伤，你是笨蛋。

say:8:1510837007:0.text: An idiot that you're kind enough to treat.
say:8:1510837007:0.source_cn: 但有人正在帮助这个笨蛋。

say:9:1510837008:0.text: Anyways, why all the questions? Did you miss me while I was gone? Seems like absence really does make the heart grow fonder.
say:9:1510837008:0.source_cn: 是因为太久没见到我了吗？分离让你变得不安。

say:13:1510837012:1.text: A charm. I made it for you.
say:13:1510837012:1.source_cn: 是我为你制作的护身符。

say:14:1510837013:1.text: It'll keep you safe. From now on, you won't be anyone's prey.
say:14:1510837013:1.source_cn: 它可以保护你。从此之后，你不会成为任何人的猎物。

say:15:1510837014:0.text: Keep it close, Perseus. Remember me when you feel it.
say:15:1510837014:0.source_cn: 珍惜它，珀尔修斯，感受我。

say:0:1510838001:0.source_cn: 那个伤害你的家伙，该让它付出代价了。

say:2:1510840001:0.source_cn: 那条项链竟然能在一瞬间治愈珀尔修斯的伤势，我得想个办法...

say:3:1510840002:0.text: Even the Wildborn's high priestesses couldn't pull off something like that, right, Merlin?
say:3:1510840002:0.source_cn: 梅林，那种魔法，连雅库伯尔的巫祭都做不到吧？

say:16:1510868011:0.text: I've raised magical wards to slow the Wildborn, but that will only hold the Wildborn army off for a short time.
say:16:1510868011:0.source_cn: 为稳定战局，我在战场上设下了魔法墙。但那只能暂时阻挡雅...

say:17:1510868012:0.text: I'll show you the battlefield. See it for yourself, then you'll know what you must do.
say:17:1510868012:0.source_cn: 我会为你展示战场的现状，看过后，你就会知道自己该做出怎...

choice:12:0:1.text: I tried to tell the truth, they didn't listen.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 我说过我不是，他们不听！
choice:12:0:1.male: I tried to tell the truth, they didn't listen.
choice:12:0:1.female: I tried to tell the truth, they didn't listen.

choice:12:1:2.text: I was put on the spot!
choice:12:1:2.male: I was put on the spot!
choice:12:1:2.female: I was put on the spot!

choice:9:0:1.text: She called your name when she descended.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 狩猎神降临时呼唤了你的名字
choice:9:0:1.male: She called your name when she descended.
choice:9:0:1.female: She called your name when she descended.

choice:9:1:2.text: She wasn't used as a sacrifice.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 雅库伯尔根本没让露去活祭！
choice:9:1:2.male: She wasn't used as a sacrifice.
choice:9:1:2.female: She wasn't used as a sacrifice.

choice:9:2:3.text: The goddess likes taking different forms.
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 狩猎神喜欢化身成不同样貌！
choice:9:2:3.male: The goddess likes taking different forms.
choice:9:2:3.female: The goddess likes taking different forms.

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 没区别，她们是同一个人

say:3:1510870001:1.text: No! Lygos... my men... What is this?!
say:3:1510870001:1.source_cn: 不！隆尔……士兵们……怎么会这样？！

say:4:1510870002:0.text: The Hunting Goddess didn't keep her word. She's been lying to you from the very start.
say:4:1510870002:0.source_cn: 狩猎神没有遵守诺言。从一开始，她就是在骗你。

say:5:1510870003:0.text: The soldiers need their general. With you there, they'll still have hope.
say:5:1510870003:0.source_cn: 你必须回去指挥战局。有你在，呼临士兵才有存活的希望。

say:6:1510870004:0.text: How do I know everything you showed me isn't just a magical illusion?
say:6:1510870004:0.source_cn: 你……怎么证明刚才的一切不是用魔法构建的幻术？

say:7:1510870005:0.text: I don't need to prove anything. If you doubt my magic, then go to the battlefield yourself.
say:7:1510870005:0.source_cn: 我不必证明。如果你不愿意相信我的魔法，更应该去风沼战场...

say:8:1510870006:0.text: Even if it's just for the comrades who entrusted you with their lives—what's so wrong about leaving this shrine for a while?
say:8:1510870006:0.source_cn: 哪怕是为了那些愿意把生命托付给你的战友，暂时离开这座神...

say:9:1510870007:0.text: If we've lied to you, you're free to return here anytime.
say:9:1510870007:0.source_cn: 如果我们欺骗了你，你随时都可以回来。

say:15:1510870013:0.text: I'm glad you've come to your senses, Perseus.
say:15:1510870013:0.source_cn: 很高兴你想通了，珀尔修斯。

choice:11:0:1.text: Halia needs you more than Gorgonna does.
choice:11:0:1.male: Halia needs you more than Gorgonna does.
choice:11:0:1.female: Halia needs you more than Gorgonna does.

say:18:1510870010:1.text: Don't say that. I'm not that kind of man!
say:18:1510870010:1.male: Don't say that. I'm not that kind of man!
say:18:1510870010:1.female: Don't say that. I'm not that kind of man!

say:1:1510872001:0.text: Perseus... You promised. You said you'd stay in the shrine. Why did you leave... Why?!
say:1:1510872001:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯……你不是答应我会留在神殿里吗？为什么跑出来…...

say:3:1510872002:0.text: I made that promise to Gorgonna. Not you, Azora!
say:3:1510872002:0.source_cn: ……我答应的是露，不是你，奥法伽！

say:4:1510872003:0.text: Gorgonna is my emissary. Her words are mine. When you agreed to her, you agreed to me.
say:4:1510872003:0.source_cn: 露是我的神使，她的要求即为我的要求！你答应了她，等于答...

say:5:1510872004:0.text: Then you betrayed your emissary! You swore not to wage war, but you went back on that promise. You ordered the Wildborn to attack, and even used divine power to interfere in the war!
say:5:1510872004:0.source_cn: 但你欺骗了你的神使！你曾许诺过不会出兵，却又违背承诺，...

say:6:1510872005:0.text: H-how... How do you know that?

say:9:1510872007:0.text: I showed him what's really happening beyond the walls of your shrine. The battlefield is drenched in blood; your blessing made sure of that. He won't just stand by and watch.
say:9:1510872007:0.source_cn: 奥法迦，我让珀尔修斯见到了真实的战况，在你的神力下，战...

say:12:1510872009:0.text: You actually believe her over me? How could you?!
say:12:1510872009:0.source_cn: 你居然相信她……你怎么可以相信她！你宁可相信她！也不肯...

say:13:1510872010:1.text: Why should I believe you? You're the goddess of the Wildborn, and I'm a Halian.
say:13:1510872010:1.source_cn: 我为什么要相信你？你是雅库伯尔信奉的狩猎神，而我是呼临人！

say:14:1510872011:0.text: Besides Gorgonna, there's nothing linking us at all!
say:14:1510872011:0.source_cn: 除了露，我和你之间没有任何交集！

say:16:1510872013:0.text: You said <style="highlight">you wouldn't hurt me</style>, but you destroyed my shrine and disturbed my slumber!

say:17:1510872014:0.text: You said to <style="highlight">cherish the gift I gave you</style>, but you won't even show it to others!
say:17:1510872014:0.source_cn: 你保证过<style=highlight>会珍惜我送的...

say:18:1510872015:0.text: You promised you'd <style="highlight">recognize me the next time we met</style>...
say:18:1510872015:0.source_cn: 你保证过<style=highlight>再见面时一定...

say:19:1510872016:0.text: Perseus, I'm right here. Why won't you recognize me?! <shk>You promised!</shk>
say:19:1510872016:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯，我就在你眼前……你为什么认不出我？<shk>...

say:23:1510872019:1.text: <shk>You've been lying to me all along!</shk>

say:24:1510872020:1.text: So what if I have?! You're mine—my prey alone! <shk>No one's taking you away from me!</shk>
say:24:1510872020:1.source_cn: 那又怎样！我不在乎！你是我一人的猎物……<shk>谁也...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510827001:.text: Now, of all times... and I don't have my spear on me...
cinematic_dialogue:2:1510827001:.source_cn: 偏偏是现在，枪不在身边……

say:5:1510828002:1.text: ... Is this the God of Harvest's blessing?

say:7:1510828003:0.text: Sarethiel has time for that? That's news to me.
say:7:1510828003:0.source_cn: 赛图恩还有这种闲心？我怎么不知道。

say:8:1510828004:1.text: Gorgonna? Why are you holding my spear?
say:8:1510828004:1.source_cn: 露？我的枪为什么在你手上？

say:9:1510828005:0.text: I found it in the sandbeast's nest while you were distracted.
say:9:1510828005:0.source_cn: 你分心对付野猪时，从它巢穴里捡来的。

say:10:1510828006:1.text: That's a sacred weapon, the God of Harvest entrusted it to me. I—
say:10:1510828006:1.source_cn: 这是丰饶神赐予我的神圣武器，我——

say:11:1510828007:0.text: No need to explain. I'm an emissary; I know exactly what it is.
say:11:1510828007:0.source_cn: 不用解释，我是神使，自然知道它是什么。

say:12:1510828008:1.text: Take it, quickly. The Hunting Goddess doesn't take kindly to Sarethiel's scent.
say:12:1510828008:1.source_cn: 快把它拿走，狩猎神不喜欢赛图恩的气息。

say:13:1510828009:1.text: Gorgonna, Sarethiel is the god I serve. Even if you follow another, don't speak ill of the one I believe in.
say:13:1510828009:1.source_cn: 露，赛图恩是我信奉的神明，就算信仰不同，也不要在我面前...

say:14:1510828010:0.text: I despise Sarethiel. What will you do about it? Kill me?
say:14:1510828010:0.source_cn: 我讨厌赛图恩，你打算怎么办？你会因此杀了我吗？

say:17:1510828013:0.text: Because you knew I was often sneaking into Wildborn land, and you never turned me in.
say:17:1510828013:0.source_cn: 因为你明知道我经常潜入雅库伯尔的领地，却没有把这个消息...

say:18:1510828014:1.text: You never harmed me. You didn't let your people harm me either. That's reason enough.
say:18:1510828014:1.source_cn: 你没有伤害我，也没有让其他兽人伤害我，所以我也不会伤害你。

say:19:1510828015:0.text: Maybe I just haven't gotten around to it.
say:19:1510828015:0.source_cn: 也许我只是还没来得及说。

say:21:1510828017:0.text: I hate people who are too sure of themselves. But... somehow, I don't hate you.
say:21:1510828017:0.source_cn: 我讨厌自信的人，可是，我似乎并不讨厌你。这真奇怪。

say:22:1510828018:1.text: You know I'm here on Halia's behalf.

say:23:1510828019:0.text: I do. And I know you won't go through with it.
say:23:1510828019:0.source_cn: 我知道。而且知道，你做不到。

say:26:1510828022:0.text: You're no hunter. Hesitate for even a heartbeat, and you won't be throwing your spear—you'll be staring down theirs, marked as prey.
say:26:1510828022:0.source_cn: 你当不成猎人。面对敌人，如果不立刻掷出长枪，反而会被盯...

say:27:1510828023:1.text: You're not my enemy. And I don't want the Wildborn to become Halia's enemy, either.
say:27:1510828023:1.source_cn: 你不是敌人。我也不希望雅库伯尔成为呼临的敌人。

say:28:1510828024:1.text: Halia's facing hardship, but you don't need to be caught up in it.
say:28:1510828024:1.source_cn: 呼临面对困境，但你们不该被卷入其中。

say:29:1510828025:0.text: Then... you're going back? Your scouting's done?
say:29:1510828025:0.source_cn: 那么，你要回去了？侦查结束了？

say:30:1510828026:1.text: Scouting is just the first step of invasion. I'll return, speak to the Regulus and the council... and never come back again.
say:30:1510828026:1.source_cn: 侦查是为了侵入，我会回去劝诫领主和议事官，然后永不再来。

say:31:1510828027:0.text: ... Perseus, will you truly never hurt me?
say:31:1510828027:0.source_cn: ……珀尔修斯，你永远都不会伤害我吗？

say:35:1510828031:1.text: Then... meet me here again. Just you and me. No one else.
say:35:1510828031:1.source_cn: 那么，再在这里相见吧。就在这里，仅你和我，再无他人。

say:37:1510828032:0.text: Why'd it have to cut off there? Just when it was getting interesting.
say:37:1510828032:0.source_cn: 怎么偏偏断在这里？真让人着急。

say:38:1510828033:0.text: Surprised to see you so invested in this, Morgan.
say:38:1510828033:0.source_cn: 摩根，我才知道你喜欢看这些。

say:39:1510828034:0.text: Well, the mood was building up. I had to at least react a bit and play along.
say:39:1510828034:0.source_cn: 气氛都到这了，我总得给点反应捧个场吧。

cinematic_dialogue:42:1510827001:.text: Now, of all times... and I don't have my spear on me...
cinematic_dialogue:42:1510827001:.source_cn: 偏偏是现在，枪不在身边……

narration:45:15010802:0.source_cn: 手无寸铁的珀尔修斯被野猪包围，露暗自施法迷晕野猪，“天...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510859001:.text: Stay with me a little longer. One more drink.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510859002:.text: Alright. I'll stay. Whatever you say.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510869003:.text: Damn Wildborn! I'll take you all on!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510869003:.source_cn: 可恶的兽人，我和你们拼了！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510816002:.text: ... I have a way to stop them.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510816006:.text: You raised a wall of light?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510816006:.male: You raised a wall of light?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510816006:.female: You raised a wall of light?

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510816009:.text: Our path is blocked. Destroy that wall!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510819101:.text: I'm not letting you get away!

cinematic_summary:1.text: Kordan and the Wildborn warriors pushed forward with unstoppable force, leaving the Halians powerless to resist.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 战场上硝烟弥漫，戈丹带领众多雅库伯尔战士倾轧而来，呼临人几乎无力抵抗。

subtitle:1:1511092001:.text: In the name of the Herdmaster!

cinematic_summary:1.text: Morgan pushed Perseus to the front, forcing the Hunting Goddess to cease her attack. Seizing the chance, Merlin brought you to safety with teleportation magic.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 摩根把珀尔修斯推至最前方，果然制止了狩猎神的攻击。初代梅林抓紧时机，用传送魔法带领你们从狩猎神面前逃离。
